News.SubTitle: First Release (Soon!)
News.Title: The first release, coming soon
Text: This is just a template for when the actual mod releases since it isn't fully released yet.

• Coven Leader
  • Hex Master
  • Medusa
  • Necromancer
  • Poisoner

• Survivor
  • Poltergeist
  • Time Rewinder
  • Snitch
  • Arsonist
  • Bomber
  • Grenadier
  • Lucky
• Role settings now have a Role Selector which can be toggled On/Off in the Settings
• Each player can set their own Backgrounds for the game (for the Main Menu) in LPR_DATA/Background
• Role settings are now organized into dedicated categories: Crewmate, Impostor, Neutral, Coven, and Modifiers
• Positioned the Main Menu to make it feel unique to the mod
There really isn't much planned yet, but there will for sure be more roles and modifiers added to the mod as the days go by.
• COMPLETELY remove Freeplay from the mod (Testing in it is useless)
• Host Utilities (Mods and Admins also included)
• Special Player Tags (Contributor, Dev Team, Tester, Translator, Sponsor ect.)
• Role/Modifier Contributing Tags (Inside the role settings)
